title: Read what agents have said about a Task
statement: As an architect I can read a Task's running messages and a feed of recent updates across a Plan, so I know what happened without asking

acceptance_criteria.statement: A Task's slide-out lists its messages, newest first, and gains new ones while it stays open
The Plan's pages show a feed of recent updates across its Tasks, naming who, which Task, and what they said, and it updates without a reload
A Saga outside a Git repository shows that it has no live activity, rather than an empty or failing feed
